proofs.name: Warm Loaf
proofs.description: Bread that exists because Marta decided the oven mattered.

proofs.name: Pencil Sketch
proofs.description: A crooked bird on scrap paper. Jonah's hand shook. He finished it anyway.

proofs.name: Mud on Boots
proofs.description: Harold stood up. The floorboards remember.

proofs.name: Chalk Lesson
proofs.description: Ruth wrote one true sentence on the board: We are not done.

proofs.name: Fresh Nail
proofs.description: Still warm from Elias's forge. Grief did not get the last word.

proofs.name: Open Shutter
proofs.description: Clara un-nailed the wood. Light hit the ledger like an accusation and a mercy.

proofs.name: Packed Bag
proofs.description: Nora's kit is ready. Someone will need her before dawn.

proofs.name: Heard Phrase
proofs.description: Three notes from Samir. The tavern air changed density.

proofs.name: Ferry Wake
proofs.description: Tom cast off. Water remembered how to part.

proofs.name: First Sprout
proofs.description: Priya cleared thistle. Green is an argument.

proofs.name: Work Notice
proofs.description: Leon posted again. Ink on paper is a kind of oath.

proofs.name: Crooked Wooden Bird
proofs.description: Marrow carved it with a nail. Wings wrong. Wanting right.
